handbook.mioscoppergolems_habour.harbour:
The Habour add-on lets golems ship goods between harbours.

# Kontor
The kontor is the warehouse and office of a harbour. Right-click it to open its 54 slots (hoppers, funnels and chutes work on it). Sneak + right-click opens the route book. Rename it in an anvil to name the harbour.

# Mooring posts
Place mooring posts at the water's edge within 24 blocks of the kontor. Boats moor in the water next to them. Without any post, boats lie in the water around the kontor itself.

# Boats
Put chest boats on the water at the harbour. Every boat needs its own captain, so a big shipment needs several boats and several captains.
A route sends goods from this kontor to another one. Open the route book (sneak + right-click the kontor) and press +.

# Settings
Destination: any other kontor in the same dimension. Cargo: click a slot with an item in your hand to set what is shipped, then use the buttons to set the amount. Right-click a slot to remove it. With no cargo set, everything in the kontor is shipped.

Runs: once, a number of times or forever. Every: the time between two runs. Start: by timer or by a redstone pulse on the kontor. Wait for full cargo: only start when all the amounts are in stock; otherwise send what is there.

Run now starts a run at once. Stop calls the current run off.

Routes also work while you are far away: the harbour wakes up now and then to look at its routes.
handbook.mioscoppergolems_habour.captain:
A captain is a copper golem holding a spyglass. Right-click a golem with a spyglass, then sneak + right-click the golem with an empty hand and right-click the kontor of its harbour.

# A voyage
The captain never carries cargo: the dockhands of the harbour load the chest boat. Then the captain climbs in, sails to the other harbour and moors at a free berth, and the dockhands there carry the cargo into the other kontor. The empty boat sails home.

Captains tire and rust like other working golems. They only start a voyage by day, but finish it at night.

If the other kontor stays full, the captain brings the rest home again.
handbook.mioscoppergolems_habour.sailing:
Captains look for a way over the water on their own and sail around headlands and bays that lead nowhere. The water must be one level: they cannot pass locks, ice or bridges lower than three blocks. While a boat is at sea, the chunks around it stay loaded.

If a captain finds no way, it turns back and brings the cargo home.

Ask the server admin for /harbour list and /harbour info to see what the harbours are up to.

handbook.mioscoppergolems_habour.railway:
Goods can travel by rail too. Place a **Railway Station** next to your track (it works like the kontor: right-click for storage, sneak + right-click for the route book) and put copper chest minecarts on the rails within 24 blocks of it.

# Conductors
A conductor is a copper golem holding a clock, linked to a station like a captain is to a kontor. It sits in the lead cart and drives the train along the track to the other station. Dockhands load and unload the carts.

# Trains
A train is a lead cart with other carts chained behind it. If a route has more cargo than one cart holds, the conductor couples free carts that stand close by, using copper chains from the station's storage: keep some chains in the station. A train takes up to five carts.

# Track
Trains follow the rails, around curves and over slopes. Junctions are not switched: a train only takes the way the rails point. At the far end the conductor turns the train round by chaining the last cart to the front. Keep the track clear of other carts.

handbook.mioscoppergolems_habour.dockhan:
A dockhand is a copper golem holding a piece of string. Make one like a captain: right-click a golem with string, then sneak + right-click it with an empty hand and right-click the kontor of its harbour.

# Work
Dockhands do all the carrying at their harbour: they load the boats that wait for a captain and unload the boats that moor there, 16 items at a time. Without a dockhand no boat is sent. The captain waits by its boat until they are done. Several dockhands can work on one boat. A dockhand never sails.

Dockhands tire and rust like other working golems.

# Where is my captain?
The route book shows where the captain of the selected route is. The Locate button makes it glow and tells you where it is.
